instruction: Candid medium close-up of two young girls in a sunny park. On the left, the curly-haired girl in a white cardigan and reddish-brown overalls (R1), wearing a dark blue hair bow, leans her head affectionately on R2's shoulder while smiling. On the right, the girl with a pink headband in a blue shirt and pink cardigan (R2) stands smiling warmly at the camera, wrapping her arm around R1's back. Warm, bright backlighting glows through the background trees.

R2 wraps her arm around R1's back
